summary: The rally has widened, with the Sensex up more than 600 pts as midcaps join in, though Snapdeal's weak debut shows IPO appetite remains selective.

detail.leaders: Financials (M&M Financial, Bajaj Finance), Kalyan Jewellers, IT
detail.tone: Gains have built on the open's momentum, with midcap financials and consumer names now joining the large-cap rally.
